Name: Run Hosted MCP ADK Agent
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Launches a Google ADK Agent integrated with a Google-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Equips the agent with dynamic OAuth credentials to query external tools and fetch procedural runbooks from Google Cloud Storage. Returns reasoning thoughts, executed tool calls, and final findings directly to the Case Wall and programmatic JSON outputs.

DynamicResults.ResultExample: {  "thoughts": [    "**My Log Search Strategy**\n\nPlan to find all error logs in project."  ],  "final_response": "Summary of findings...",  "tool_calls": [    {      "tool": "list_log_entries",      "args": {        "filter": "severity >= ERROR"      }    }  ],  "code_logs": []}

Parameters.Description: The prompt or security investigation instruction for the MCP-enabled agent.
Thinking budget (token count) for model reasoning (e.g. 1024).
Comma-separated whitelist of specific MCP tools to make available to the agent (e.g. 'udm_search, translate_udm_query').
